vehicle_counting.method: 2D line-crossing segment intersection with persistent counted_track_ids set
vehicle_counting.guarantee: Zero duplicate counts of stalled/oscillating tracks

traffic_density_and_congestion.method: 60-second temporal window vehicle proxy grouping and density tiers

persistent_bottleneck_detection.method: Multi-window recurrence requirement (>= 2 congested windows in same spatial corridor)

route_delay_analysis.method: Haversine segment travel time vs prototype free-flow baseline (30 km/h)

congestion_heatmap_geojson.method: Spatial binning of verified vehicle perception points into GeoJSON FeatureCollection

speed_estimation.reason: Camera optics and perspective transform uncalibrated

lane_occupancy.reason: Lane boundary geometric model not deployed
